subject: revenuesystem.visual_rebase.execution_partition
summary: Owner required the Editorial Financial Engraving rebase to be executed in exactly three bounded sections to avoid long-run interruption. Only one section may be open at a time; each section must close with exact SHA, CI, artifacts/screenshots, and Council+Studio verdict before the next opens.

sections.scope: Design system, Shell, Day Console, Cashier Workbench, Finance Ledger, shared components and compact behavior
Data Operations, Administration, Login/Lock/onboarding, remaining reachable dialogs/states/legacy surfaces, final whole-product visual reacceptance
